---
title: "drawgraph"
output: html_document
date: "2025-12-06"
---

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)

# === Step1: 正確讀取 CSV（保留文字） ===
df_result <- read.csv("result.txt", header = TRUE, sep = ",", quote = "")

# 確認欄位內容
print(df_result)

# === Step2: 設定 model 為因子（照原始順序）===
df_result$model <- factor(df_result$model,
                          levels = df_result$model)

# === Step3: 再 pivot 成長表格 ===
df_plot <- df_result %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(borrow_count, restock, earning),
    names_to = "metric",
    values_to = "value"
  )

# === Step4: 反向排序（Model 1 在最上面） ===
df_plot$model <- factor(
  df_plot$model,
  levels = rev(levels(df_result$model))
)

print(df_plot)


```

```{r plot compare}
p_borrow <- df_plot %>%
  filter(metric == "borrow_count") %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = value, y = model)) +
  geom_col(fill = "steelblue") +
  labs(
    x = "Borrow Count",
    y = "Model",
    title = "Borrow Count Across Model"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 12),
    plot.title = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold", hjust = 0.5)
  )

p_borrow


```

```{r plot earning}
p_restock <- df_plot %>%
```

```{r}

ggsave("plot_borrow.png",  p_borrow, width = 6, height = 4, dpi = 300)
```
